title: Multiplicity one makes the IM measure dominated by Hⁿ
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝᴾ any set, and R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] and θ = R.mult. Let B ⊆ ℝᴾ be measurable, and assume θ(x) = R.mult x = 1 for μ-a.e. x ∈ B. Then μ⌞B ≤ Hⁿ⌞B as measures (R.measure.restrict B ≤ μHE[n].restrict B). Moreover, for every set A ⊆ B and every function h : ℝᴾ → [0, ∞] (no measurability assumed), ∫⁻_A h dμ ≤ ∫⁻_A h dHⁿ (lower Lebesgue integrals over the restricted measures).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (B : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet B → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ B → R.mult x = 1) → R.measure.restrict B ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict B ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), A ⊆ B → (∫⁻ x in A, h x ∂R.measure) ≤ ∫⁻ x in A, h x ∂μHE[n]
